Percy Jackson and the Olympians | Season 3 Watch Party | Disney+
In anticipation of Season 3, the Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 Watch Party features Walker Scobell (Percy Jackson), Leah Sava' Jeffries (Annabeth Chase), Aryan Simhadri (Grover Underwood), Charlie Bushnell (Luke Castellan), Tamara Smart (Thalia Grace), and Levi Chrisopulos (Nico di Angelo) as they break down episodes 1 and 2 by taking you behind the scenes, sharing stories from set, and giving viewers exclusive insight into the making of the show.
